Leftmost of two inputs begins below bottom with an upward arrowhead, crosses bottom, and meets left oblique side near its lower portion.
Second input lies right of leftmost input, begins below bottom with an upward arrowhead, crosses bottom and meets left oblique side at a higher point.
A lower near-horizontal interior ray runs from the lower left-side junction to the lower right-side junction, with no interruption of its major path.

From the lower right-side junction a near-vertical segment goes downward across the bottom and ends with a downward arrowhead farther right.

Two separate paths each have two turns, one on each oblique side. Leftmost input connects via lower horizontal path to rightmost output; inner input via upper path to inner output. Four bottom crossings and four sloping-side turns have no definite named/dotted point markers.

Both rays enter from below on the left, touch left slope, cross horizontally, touch right slope and descend out through bottom on the right. No visible separate normal, auxiliary axis or dashed optical path.
